scope: Direct BOSE string activity traces: raw groups, ranked signed change points, signed options and RNG state
limits: No module or dispatcher status promotion.
String activity labels only; Python non-string labels and container identity remain outside this typed API.
Explicit seeds and resource limits are native extensions.
Rejection acceptance is compared, not language-specific exception classes.
The numeric implementation targets the previously observed pinned NumPy/OpenBLAS runtime.
DataFrame adapters and returned DataFrame metadata remain unverified.
